# GZip

Compress text to Base64 GZip and decompress it back.

Category: Encoders · ID: `gzip` · Search terms: gz, compress, decompress, deflate, zip

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui gzip [encode|decode] [file|-] [flags]
```

## Inputs

1. Input

## Options

| Flag | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--mode` | `encode`, `decode` | `encode` | Mode. |
| `--level` | 1–9 | `6` | Level. Compression level: 1 fastest, 9 smallest |
| `--output` | `auto`, `text`, `hex` | `auto` | Output. When decoding: auto shows hex if the result is binary |

## Examples

From the tests (`testdata/gzip`), so they are what the tool prints.

### encode-text

```text
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
Café, jalapeño and 🍕.
```

